name: Kamiki Mia
source:
Because of circumstances relating to her parents, she comes to live in the protagonist's home.
In stark contrast to Setsura, she dislikes quiet places with no people and instead likes lively places.
She is the type to liven up places that have a solemn mood to them.
It may not show on her face, but she is delighted to have become part of a new family.
She doesn't have a complex about her under-developed body and she has an energetic, positive personality.
